Why a partnership

Do not wait for a system
to become a problem.

Your website, lead journey and business workflows change as your company grows. A one-time project can create a strong starting point, but the systems still need practical improvement as customer needs, staff processes and tools change.

With Dakyworld, monthly work is planned around the improvements that matter most, rather than waiting until the business is forced into another expensive rebuild.

01

Better customer journeys

Improve the website, landing pages, lead capture and next steps that turn interest into enquiries, bookings or sales.

02

Less manual work

Reduce repeated tasks, handoffs and follow-up gaps with practical workflow automation.

03

Connected tools

Keep agreed forms, CRM, WhatsApp, payments, calendars, reporting and other business tools working together as your process develops.

04

Clear direction

Receive a clear update, priority plan and guidance for making sound digital-system decisions.

Ongoing work

What a monthly partnership looks like.

Four things happen every month, whether or not anything has gone wrong.

01

Prioritise

We agree the most useful work for the month based on business priorities, live issues and the existing roadmap.

02

Build, connect or improve

We use the agreed capacity to deliver the work: improving a page, refining a lead flow, building an automation, connecting systems, improving reporting or training the team.

03

Review

You receive a plain-language update explaining what changed, what was learned, what needs a decision and what we recommend next.

04

Plan ahead

Growth and Transformation plans include regular forward planning so work supports the next business priority rather than only responding to requests.

Clear terms

Clear capacity.
Clear ownership.

Monthly work is defined by capacity and agreed priorities. Any task outside the scope, capacity or active roadmap is estimated and approved as a separate project before work begins.

After the initial Founding Partner period or another agreed initial term, plans run month to month and may end with 30 days' written notice.

Your business retains ownership of its domains, accounts, source files and data.

Hosting, domains, CRM licences, automation-platform subscriptions, AI-tool subscriptions, paid plugins, payment-processing fees, advertising spend and other third-party costs are billed separately unless a written proposal says otherwise.

Common questions

Simple answers before you start.

Are these plans really month to month?+

Yes, after the initial Founding Partner period or any other period agreed in your proposal. You may end the arrangement with 30 days' written notice.

What counts as routine website work?+

Examples include agreed content updates, page refinements, conversion improvements and minor changes within your monthly allocation. New sections, major redesigns, additional websites and complex features are separately scoped.

Can you support every tool we use?+

No. Each proposal names the systems Dakyworld will work on. We focus on the website, workflows, automations and connections most relevant to the agreed business goals.

Can we start with a project instead?+

Yes. A defined project is often best when you have a clear immediate outcome, such as a website, automation, integration or workshop.

Can you build a custom plan?+

Yes. Transformation engagements are built around your systems, priorities, stakeholders and required delivery capacity.
